scope: Current-code inspection of the next P2 feature and its unresolved destructive-data semantics. This is not an implemented or accepted deletion feature, security scan, legal retention assessment or release approval.

current_state.finding: The administrative HardDeleteUser explicitly refuses self-deletion and deletion of a platform administrator. It cannot be exposed as the self-service API without a distinct policy and authorization contract.
Existing administrative deletion enumerates every owned server and calls the server cascade. A self-service action must not silently inherit deletion of entire shared servers.

File URL collection currently covers owned-server assets and personal entrance clips. The function's current documented behavior leaves the user's avatar and attachments in other servers/DMs unswept on disk; a deleted database reference is not proof of blob erasure.

The tail still depends on database cascades for remaining user-related data. Explicit cleanup exists for selected newer tables, but it is not evidence of complete cleanup when remote foreign-key enforcement is absent.

Existing one-to-one DM channels reference both users with DELETE CASCADE, and messages/attachments cascade from the channel. Reusing that cascade can remove another participant's shared history, not just the deleting account's authored messages.

decision_requested.mechanism: One concise asynchronous user question; no default response submitted automatically.
decision_requested.question: When an account is deleted, should shared history remain under an anonymized deleted identity, or should the account's authored messages and attachments also be permanently removed?
options: Preserve shared history under an anonymized deleted identity (recommended option shown to the user).
Remove the account's authored messages and attachments.
decision_requested.state: answered: preserve shared history under an anonymized deleted identity
decision_requested.user_answer: Silinen hesabın kimliğini anonimleştir; paylaşılan geçmiş diğer kişilerde kalsın (önerilen).
decision_requested.not_authorized_by_this_assessment: No irreversible production deletion, owned-server deletion, administrative impersonation or choice of retention policy has occurred.

implementation_requirements_after_choice: Distinct owner-bound self-service endpoint; active header session, current password, enabled second factor, durable attempt budget, explicit typed confirmation and account-generation response guard.
Surface actual owned servers and required administrative handoff. Do not silently delete shared servers as a side effect of self-deletion.

Keep private account data, encryption keys/backups, sessions, tokens, notes, preferences and integration records separate from the selected shared-history treatment. Do not send silently decrypted message evidence to the server.
Implement durable, retryable cleanup of uniquely owned blobs with safe path validation and surviving-reference checks; database deletion alone must not report complete file erasure.

Test local and foreign-key-disabled schemas, cleanup failure/retry, concurrent writes, ownership changes, other-user data preservation, realtime revocation, actual downloadable files and the selected history contract.
Explain the exact operation and backup/retention limitations before irreversible confirmation. No generic promise of retroactively erasing copies already downloaded by other users.
other_work: The user has selected anonymization with shared-history preservation; this branch no longer awaits a retention choice. Finish email verification evidence, then implement the distinct self-service contract. The full P0-P11 goal remains active and incomplete. No commit, push, merge, Windows update or production deployment was performed.
